correctness.rationale: Independence of two zero-based geometric increments gives the exact rational PGF and population mean/variance identification. The stage-pair and total scores at equal component rates were reconstructed and their Fisher informations 2/a and 1/(3a^2) checked by exact factorial-moment algebra. Adjacent parameter differences are exactly 2/[(2m-1)(2m+1)] and 8m/[(2m-1)^2(2m+1)^2]. Locally regular likelihood families with geometric-tail bounds give normal LLRs and product-KL lower bounds; the nuisance-free moment tests attain the Gaussian errors. The embedded code passed 6029 exact rational finite diagnostics. Risks: the analytic regularity and LAN theorem are proved at the level of uniform geometric tail bounds, not formally verified.

originality.rationale: The 2022 source proves the negative-occupancy law and gives a convolution of geometric increments, but does not analyze adjacent hidden-bin inference when the usable-draw rate is unknown. The 2022/2023 follow-up studies Markov chains and distribution properties, not the two data-recording schemes. A relevant published geometric-sum signed-correction theorem approximates heterogeneous sums, but does not supply the fourth-versus-sixth-power detection comparison or exact Gaussian errors. Explicit published-finding corpus queries for aliases, sample exponents and moment inversion and external searches did not reveal covering results. This is best-knowledge, not proof of global novelty.
residual_risks: Broad classical asymptotic-information results could support an equivalent proof; the specific historical literature on unknown coupon population size has not been exhaustively inspected.
The comparison with the original arXiv preprint used earliest-date metadata and the full journal HTML of the same paper, not direct parsing of all preprint pages.
No independent historical priority validation was performed.

value.rationale: Estimating the unknown number of coupon types from replicated two-hit stopping times is a natural inverse problem with uncertainty in the usability/detection rate. The exact moment inversion clarifies identifiability; the two observation protocols have rigorously different sharp minimax replication thresholds m^6 versus m^4, with explicit optimum Gaussian testing errors and practical nuisance-free moment tests. The two-power information loss is substantive and not a routine extra computed cumulant or arbitrary parameter slice.
